posts.name: Clutch: Predict the News
posts.tagline: Bet on the news, be right, earn money
posts.description: Free-to-play prediction markets. Predict the news, compete with friends, and climb the leaderboard. No money, just credits.

posts.name: CloudFuze
posts.tagline: Microsoft 365 Copilot to Google Gemini Migration Guide
posts.description: CloudFuze helps enterprises seamlessly migrate Microsoft 365 Copilot conversations to Google Gemini while preserving AI context, conversation history, and knowledge. Ensure a secure, compliant transition to Google Workspace without losing valuable AI insights.

posts.name: Onsight
posts.tagline: On-demand local photo missions, starting in San Francisco
posts.description: Onsight is on-demand local photography, starting in San Francisco. Need a photo of a specific place you can't get to - a storefront, a rental or STR listing, a product on a shelf, an event? Post a "mission" with the spot and the shot you need, and a vetted local photographer near that pin shoots it fresh and geotagged. Two sides: post missions and get photos, or apply to nearby missions and shoot. SF first, more cities coming - get in early.

posts.name: AiSpace Xintel
posts.tagline: Synthesize X (Twitter) intelligence.
posts.description: Xintel turns a public X account into a structured intelligence profile that evolves over time. It gathers the account’s posts and the conversations around them, measures them in depth, and uses AI to explain what the numbers mean — then repeats the process so you can see how the account is shifting, not just how it looks today. The same profile also models how the account writes, so you can draft in a voice that matches it instead of a generic one.

posts.name: Smeltr
posts.tagline: The non-custodial Token-2022 launcher for Solana
posts.description: Deploy Solana Token-2022 tokens without writing code — and without surrendering your mint authority. Pick from composable extension modules (transfer fees, soul-bound locks, permanent delegate), upload metadata to Arweave, and sign with your wallet. No account needed. No custody. Your mint authority is yours from block one. Built on Solana's native Token-2022 program — no third-party smart contracts. Includes an MCP server for AI-assisted config validation.

posts.name: FreeWWW IP Address Lookup
posts.tagline: Check your IP, network details, location, and privacy
posts.description: Instantly detect your IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and explore detailed information about your internet connection. View your approximate location, ISP, timezone, connection type, and an interactive map. Check for VPN, proxy, WebRTC leak, and page-security issues. Copy details, view locally stored history, share results, print, or export as JSON—free with no signup.

posts.name: ProofBench
posts.tagline: Know which idea to build, before you build it
posts.description: ProofBench spins up a fake-door landing page for each of your ideas, tracks who signs up and who clicks "buy", and ranks them by conversion and buy-intent rate — not vanity views. So you build the one people actually want. One-time payment, no subscription.

posts.name: Clariv
posts.tagline: AI Customer Sentiment & Reputation Management Platform
posts.description: Clariv.ai helps businesses analyze customer sentiment, manage reviews, and engage audiences using AI-powered insights.

posts.name: Vernac
posts.tagline: Your AI Daily Vocabulary Coach
posts.description: Vernac is an AI vocabulary coach that learns your life and delivers words in context that sticks. Swipe, learn, remember — one minute a day. iOS & Android.

posts.name: Photoreal Hairstyle Try-On
posts.tagline: Your face and lighting stay. Only the hair changes. 28 cuts.
posts.description: Try on hairstyles on your own photo, free. An AI hairstyle simulator with 28 hairstyles, each shown from the front, side and back, so you know exactly what to ask your barber for.

posts.name: Verified Launches
posts.tagline: Verified Launches. Trusted Discoveries.
posts.description: Verified Launches is a platform to discover and upvote the best tech products. Find top products launching daily.

posts.name: Airspace Live
posts.tagline: Military Inspired Tactical Flight Tracker, AR, & Watch.
posts.description: A tactical flight radar with a military-style analog scope, in your pocket and on your wrist. An instrument, not another map. Every other flight tracker gives you a map covered in icons. No subscription. Augment Reality (AR) plane tracking. Point and find out. Collectible Plane Cards & Flight Deck. Search and track any aircraft. No subscription, no ads, no account needed. Just clean execution.

posts.name: Marakadhey
posts.tagline: Never Miss Opportunities
posts.description: Marakadhey is a Productive Chrome extension that helps you save important webpages, organize opportunities, and receive timely reminders before critical deadlines. Whether it's an internship application, coding assignment, scholarship, webinar, hackathon, certification, registration, or any important opportunity, Marakadhey ensures you never miss what matters.

posts.name: Complete Study Toolkit (FREE)
posts.tagline: Free AI study companion — summaries, quizzes, flashcards
posts.description: StudyMind AI is a free AI-powered study companion — a summarizer, quiz generator, flashcard maker, and 24/7 AI tutor, all in one browser tool. No card, no trial period, no account needed. It's genuinely free, not a limited demo of something paid. Built for students who need real study help without another subscription. Powered by Claude AI.

posts.name: Fish Audio S2.1 Pro
posts.tagline: Build voice AI apps without expensive API costs
posts.description: Fish Audio S2.1 Pro Free API brings advanced AI voice generation to developers at no cost. With support for 83 languages and unlimited access under Fair Use, developers can prototype voice agents, games, audiobooks, and creative applications without worrying about expensive API bills. A powerful voice model that makes building natural, expressive speech experiences more accessible than ever.

posts.name: Cited
posts.tagline: Search rankings were yesterday. AI citations are next.
posts.description: Cited tracks when your brand appears in answers from AI search engines, which competitors are being recommended instead, and what you can do to earn more visibility.

posts.name: Unridden
posts.tagline: A game of riding as many trails and trail areas as you can
posts.description: Unridden tracks your mountain biking progress across the trails of every supported area. Connect Strava (or others), ride your local trails, earn completion badges and prizes, and enjoy scheming how to ride all the trails.

posts.name: AgentCall
posts.tagline: Let your AI make real phone calls from your own phone
posts.description: AgentCall connects an Android default-dialer application to a Windows or Linux desktop through one authenticated USB cable. It supports real cellular calls, PC microphone and speaker mode, realtime STT/TTS, local recordings, phone-data synchronization, and semantic call control from Hermes or OpenClaw over MCP.

posts.name: SEMrush Free Website Stats Scraper
posts.tagline: Export public SEMrush website stats to a dataset
posts.description: Scrape public SEMrush website overview pages for supported domains. Get authority score, visits, organic search traffic, referring domains, backlinks, source URLs, and timestamps in an Apify dataset.

posts.name: MyArbora
posts.tagline: Design your food forest on a satellite map of your land
posts.description: Draw your plot on a satellite map. MyArbora estimates your soil, rainfall, frost risk and slope from the coordinates, then designs a companion-plant guild around a tree you choose — placed to scale at mature size, with harvest and planting calendars. 300+ species. Free, no signup.

posts.name: aitexttohandwriting
posts.tagline: Text to Handwriting Converter
posts.description: Turn typed text into handwritten pages with custom fonts, paper styles, layout controls, and PNG, PDF, or ZIP export—no account required.

posts.name: Kegwatch
posts.tagline: Keep every Mac app up to date, from one place
posts.description: A free macOS updater for Homebrew, Cask, Mac App Store, and Sparkle/Electron apps — from one place.

posts.name: Phloz
posts.tagline: The agency CRM that proves your tracking works
posts.description: The CRM + work management platform for digital marketing agencies — with a typed, auditable map of every client's tracking (GA4, GTM, pixels, conversions), scored and audited weekly. Catch broken tracking before your client does. Priced per active client, not per seat.

posts.name: Sayfess
posts.tagline: The stories human love to read
posts.description: Sayfess is an anonymous collection of stories, secrets, and confessions. Read real, unfiltered thoughts from around the world.

posts.name: Foyer
posts.tagline: Spatial ambient sound rooms, now on iPhone
posts.description: Foyer turns ambient sound into a place. You're a point of light on a black canvas, and each sound (a hearth, rain, a stream, a distant city) is a glowing orb you drag around yourself with your thumb. Pull one closer and it swells; slide it and it pans. It's real binaural spatial audio, now on iPhone, with lock-screen controls and AirPods head tracking. One purchase unlocks Mac and iPhone.
